title: Data and corpus provenance qualifications
provenance_caveat: Separates execution-bound facts from qualified or unresolved source conventions.

records.manuscript_safe_wording: The supplied BJD-2450000 coordinate was retained without conversion; a more specific time standard was not independently established.
records.consequence: Do not label the coordinate as a specific BJD time scale.

records.manuscript_safe_wording: Kp is treated as the reported magnitude-like photometric quantity.
records.consequence: Do not claim absolute or calibrated apparent-magnitude semantics.

records.manuscript_safe_wording: Kp_err is retained as supplied source metadata; its detailed statistical/calibration semantics were not independently established.
records.consequence: Kp_err was not propagated; canonical flux_error is None and Lomb–Scargle analysis is unweighted.

records.manuscript_safe_wording: The broader corpus registry contains 14 workbook-derived source products; unconfirmed metadata remain unresolved.
records.consequence: Only registry-supported fields are reported; bibliography reconciliation remains necessary.

records.manuscript_safe_wording: The experimental source is Molnár et al. (2015), “An RR Lyrae family portrait: 33 stars observed in Pisces with K2-E2.”
records.consequence: Supports publication-level observing and sample context, not project-processing details.

records.manuscript_safe_wording: The frozen pilot contains 33 astronomical objects and 33 light-curve products.
records.consequence: Defines the machine-learning sample size as 33 objects.

records.manuscript_safe_wording: All 14,338 input rows survived finite filtering and were retained.
records.consequence: The measurements are nested within objects and are not independent ML observations.

records.manuscript_safe_wording: The frozen experiment uses one K2-E2 RR Lyrae source and does not establish cross-mission or cross-class generalization.
records.consequence: Limit claims to the frozen pilot scope.
